post_clip.description: A large cylindrical object (likely a tanker or pipe) is lying横 across the road at an intersection, blocking traffic lanes. This suggests a recent vehicle accident—possibly a truck overturning or cargo detachment—resulting in a hazardous obstruction. No active collision is visible in these frames, but the presence of the overturned load and associated debris/cones indicates a prior crash. A pedestrian walks near the scene, seemingly observing, which further supports that this is an abnormal post-incident situation.
